usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts, and Salesmate logs a follow-up through “Create Activity” after an “Abandoned Checkout”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Activity” in Salesmate
bestTemplate.why: The abandoned checkout becomes an activity in the CRM, so someone owns the chase.

watchOut: “Add Note” and “Create Activity” use details from the previous step, so map the checkout fields.
